title: Formation Control with Pole Placement for Multi-agent Systems
evidence_note: For continuous-time single-integrator leader-follower systems, theorem body requires a leader-rooted directed spanning tree and acyclic graph for arbitrary real pole placement; small examples only, no hardware experiments. Abstract omits the acyclic condition stated in the theorem.

title: Automated Code Generation for Lattice Quantum Chromodynamics and beyond
review_status: full-text section audit complete; adjacent-field/AI-screen false positive
topic_adjudication: Adjacent broad automatic code generation; not AI/ML-generated code. PDF primary category hep-lat.
evidence_note: QIRAL translates a domain-specific LaTeX algorithm notation into OpenMP C for LQCD and compares selected kernels on legacy CPUs/Xeon Phi. Performance/parallel efficiency depend on hand-tuned libraries, memory placement, and hardware topology; not a general code generation benchmark.

title: Efficient Clustering with Limited Distance Information
review_status: full-text section audit complete; sampled v2 independently rechecked
evidence_note: Rechecked against the fixed-frame v2 full text after discovering the earlier ledger incorrectly said v1. O(k+log(1/delta)) one-versus-all query guarantee is conditional on the (1+alpha,epsilon)-stability property and target clusters of size at least (4+51/alpha)epsilon*n. Pfam clustering is near gold labels for most datasets but not sets 7 and 9; results are weaker on SCOP and comparable to spectral methods using full distances; authors connect this to SCOP’s structure/biochemical labels and weaker sequence-similarity cluster separation. Parameter sensitivity is reported.

title: Opening the Black Boxes in Data Flow Optimization
sections_checked: §§3–6 static UDF read/write analysis and safe reordering
evidence_note: A Stratosphere/PACT prototype extracted reorder properties for four workloads and improved selected plan runtime substantially, but only three timing runs per plan; optimizer lacks indexes/columnar/materialized views and efficient enumeration pruning, while SCA handles only compile-time-visible accesses.

title: Min-Sum Clustering of Protein Sequences with Limited Distance Information
review_status: full-text citation-follow-up audit complete; same-team evidence, not independent replication
sections_checked: §1 relation to 2010 Landmark-Clustering and objective assumptions
Theorem 1 query guarantee and cluster-size conditions
§5 experiments on same Pfam/SCOP data and matched query budgets
evidence_note: Changing objective/stability condition helped on Pfam sets where original Landmark-Clustering faltered but not most Pfam sets; methods comparable on SCOP. Same author team and reused datasets, so this is a within-lineage comparison, not an independent replication.
